name: io.github.CyberPunk11147/cyberwarex-defi-oracle
description: MCP server for the CyberWareX DeFi Safety Oracle: deterministic buy/sell honeypot + transfer-tax simulation, contract-power analysis, and A-F token safety grades for Base and BSC. Tools: token_safety, honeypot_check, contract_risk.

environmentVariables.name: DSO_X_PAYMENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional x402 X-PAYMENT header. If unset, the server surfaces the 402 invoice to the agent so its own x402 client can pay and retry.
